_meta.description: Verified crisis and support resources for the Kashmir Valley mental-health companion. This file is SAFETY-CRITICAL and MUST be bundled for offline rendering (the region experiences frequent internet shutdowns). Every change requires re-verification against the cited source.

verification_legend.verified: Confirmed against an authoritative/official source as of last_verified.
verification_legend.partial: Service exists and is authoritative, but a specific detail (number, hours, J&K coverage, or language) is not fully confirmed.
verification_legend.unverified: Listed for completeness; a key detail is unconfirmed. Do NOT present to users without re-verification.

do_not_cite.name: KIRAN
do_not_cite.reason: Merged into Tele-MANAS; standalone-answering status unconfirmed. Route users to Tele-MANAS 14416 instead. Never present KIRAN as an independent active line.

rendering_rules: Always surface Tele-MANAS (14416) first for any mental-health distress.
For imminent danger to life, surface ERSS 112 first, then Tele-MANAS.
Time-gated resources (time_gated: true) MUST NOT be shown as available outside their hours; show the after_hours_fallback instead.
Never present a non-24/7 line as a crisis/after-hours option.
Match the resource's listed languages to the user's language where possible; if Urdu coverage is not 'verified', do not promise Urdu support.

primary_crisis.name: Tele-MANAS (National Tele Mental Health Programme)
primary_crisis.languages_note: English + 20 regional languages including Urdu (verified). Kashmiri availability not separately confirmed.
primary_crisis.jk_operator: IMHANS-K (Institute of Mental Health and Neurosciences, Kashmir) at Government Medical College Srinagar; J&K cell launched 2022-11-04. J&K nodal officer: Dr Arshid Hussain.
primary_crisis.confidentiality: Calls not audio-recorded; caller number masked; unique Tele-MANAS ID assigned; 'prefer not to say' on all demographics.
primary_crisis.chatbot_note: J&K Tele-MANAS chatbot (AI + two-way expert communication), launched July 2023.

primary_crisis.name: Emergency Response Support System (police / fire / medical)
primary_crisis.use_when: Imminent danger to life or safety (active suicide attempt in progress, violence in progress, medical emergency).

primary_crisis.name: Kashmir Lifeline
primary_crisis.operator_correction: NOT Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF). MSF's Kashmir role was the 2015 Kashmir Mental Health Survey, a separate effort.
primary_crisis.cost: free (works from a zero-balance phone); anonymous
primary_crisis.providers_note: All care providers are Kashmiri and trauma-informed. Project of Healing Minds Foundation; clinic in Baghat, Srinagar, plus district outreach.
primary_crisis.safety_note: NEVER present as a 24/7 or after-hours crisis line. Outside listed hours, show Tele-MANAS instead.

population_specific.name: Childline (children in need of care/protection)
population_specific.operator: Mission Vatsalya (Ministry of Women & Child Development)

population_specific.name: Women Helpline (Sambal / Mission Shakti)
population_specific.jk_status: Operational in J&K since Oct 2017 via the J&K State Resource Centre for Women; integrated with Sakhi One Stop Centres (OSCs). Access OSCs via 181.
population_specific.verification_note: National line verified; precise J&K integration/coverage is partial.

population_specific.name: Sakhi One Stop Centres (OSC) — J&K
population_specific.audience: women facing violence (medical, legal, psychosocial, shelter support)
population_specific.count_note: Best-documented figure: 19 OSCs in J&K as of April 2022 — verify current count against the live Mission Shakti dashboard (missionshakti.wcd.gov.in) before hard-coding.

general_support.name: Vandrevala Foundation
general_support.data_note: Conversations are stored (per their FAQ). The older 1860-2662-345 number is outdated.

deaddiction.name: IMHANS Drug De-Addiction Centre (CGHU at SMHS Hospital, Karan Nagar, Srinagar)
services: free medicines via AIIMS New Delhi Drug Treatment Clinic
deaddiction.note: Addiction Treatment Facilities (ATFs) at GMC Srinagar, Anantnag, and Handwara. De-addiction OPD in all 20 districts; IPD in all 9 GMCs.

clinical_services.name: IMHANS — Institute of Mental Health and Neurosciences, Kashmir
clinical_services.affiliation: Psychiatry department of Government Medical College (GMC) Srinagar
sites: 30-bed Community General Hospital Unit (CGHU) within the SMHS Hospital complex, Karan Nagar

legal_aid.name: J&K State Legal Services Authority (JKSLSA) helpline
